## Journal Articles

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
cat(render_pubs_list(
  "pubs.ris",
  format = "cv_year",
  types  = "JOUR"
))
```

## Book Chapters

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
chap_list <- render_pubs_list(
  "pubs.ris",
  format = "cv_year",
  types  = "CHAP"
)
if (nzchar(chap_list)) cat(chap_list)
```
